A few things
you might ask.

Or ask us directly.
info@theimamcollective.com

Where do you work?+

We collaborate with teams worldwide. We agree working hours, communication channels and handover arrangements around each project.

Can we start with one service?+

Yes. Start with the problem that matters now. We can connect other capabilities when the work calls for them.

How are projects priced?+

Platform estimates are displayed in USD. Implementation, custom software, marketing and training are scoped separately with clear deliverables.

Can you work with the tools we already use?+

We review your existing systems first. Keeping and connecting a useful tool can be better than replacing it.

How do we begin?+

Share the problem, the current process and the outcome you want. We will review the brief and discuss a practical next step.

Let’s make the next move count.

A clearer process. A better product. A new way forward. Tell us what you have in mind.
